newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HAAPSALU-RIISIPERE RAILWAY TO BE PRIVATISED.
newsitem.headline: HAAPSALU-RIISIPERE RAILWAY TO BE PRIVATISED.

text.p: The Estonian privatisation agency has offered the Riisipere-Haapsalu railway line, an important link to the west coast, for sale by tender, the agency said on Monday.
"The deadline for tenders, which includes the railway line's boundaries, superstructures and embankments will close on July 17," Linna Magi, foreign realations advisor, told Reuters.
"The tenders are also to include a business plan for the line," she added.
The line, about 69 km long, is currently a goods line and was closed to passenger traffic during the last year.
